_comment: Layout for tools/build_streamdeck_profile.py. Cue names must match the Lightkey show exactly.
Each page is rows x columns (grid). A cell is a cue name, LABEL (page title, needs a Text key in the
template export), NEXT, PREV, or null for an empty key.
Key mode, MIDI note/channel and latch group are read from the show, not written here.
channels: only consider bindings on these MIDI channels (cue names can repeat across panels).
group_prefix: only exclusive groups whose name starts with this become latch groups; the prefix is
stripped from the key's category text and the latch group name.
latch_prefix: Stream Deck latch groups are global across ALL profiles, so give them a prefix.
keys: optional artwork per cue: category (small top line), lines (big text), colors (hex list, or
'look' to take the deepest and palest colour the cue shows in the show). Also mode / channel / group
to override what the show implies (rarely needed).
